anchors.quote: پس من به نظرم که حتماً بذارید توی رزومهتون
حتی اگه شرکت به طور خاص الان نخواد این یه پلاسه برای اینکه من می‌فهمم این طرف اگه من نیاز بشم

claim_en: Put technologies outside the target role on the CV: even if the company does not ask for them, they are a plus, because the hiring manager understands the candidate could help if needed.
quote_en: So in my view, definitely put it in your CV. / Even if the company does not specifically want it now, this is a plus, because I understand that this person, if needed...

anchors.quote: حجم ارتباطشم یهکم مهمه دیگه
یه چیزای خیلی خیلی بیرپت دیگه نباشه دیگه یعنی یه چیزا باشه بالاخره به اون شغله یه جورایی ارتباطی داشته باشه

claim_en: Technologies outside the target role should still relate to the job somehow; how related they are matters a little, and very unrelated ones should not be listed.
quote_en: How related it is matters a bit too. / There should not be things that are very, very unrelated; there should be things that relate to that job in some way.

anchors.quote: ما چند ده تا به راحتی چند صد تا وضع بعضیتشون بستگی به شغل
اگه فقط رو سایت بذاریم خب خیلی کمتر میاد به نسبت ولی وقتی میری ری لینکدین پست می‌کنی
وقتی میری تو سایتهای زیاد شیر می‌کنی یهو یه چیز تصاعدی یه عدد خیلی گنده‌ای میاد

claim_en: At the recruiter's company a role easily gets tens, for some roles hundreds, of CVs depending on the job; posted only on the company site it gets far fewer, while posting on LinkedIn and many job sites brings a very large number.
quote_en: We get several tens easily, several hundred for some, depending on the job. / If we only put it on the site, far fewer come in comparison, but when you post on LinkedIn... / When you share on many sites, suddenly an exponential, very big number comes in.

anchors.quote: این بررسی منج یه نفر دیگه بشینه رو این صندلی بشینه یه جور دیگه ممکنه جواب بده
شما اپلای می‌کنی ۱۰ تا شرکت د تاشون تو رو اکسپت می‌کنن ولی ۸ تا دیگه ریجکتش می‌کنن
چون آدمای مختلفی اون پشت نشستن

claim_en: The verdicts are one screener's review: someone else in the same chair might answer differently, which is why two of ten companies may accept a CV and eight reject it, because different people sit behind them.
quote_en: This review is mine; if someone else sat in this chair, they might answer differently. / You apply to 10 companies, two of them accept you but the other 8 reject it. / Because different people sit behind it.

anchors.quote: معمولاً وقتی که وقت داریم می‌ذاریم اپلای کن مثلاً یهو یه باکت خیلی زیادی مثلاً می‌بینیم توی اونجا هست
همین که اپلای می‌کنه شاید روزی دو بار مثلاً من برم چک کنم
نگاه می‌کنم این خوب بود همونجا دعوتش می‌کنم

claim_en: When there is time to fill a role, the recruiter lets applications build up and then reviews the batch quickly; for an urgent role they check new applications perhaps twice a day and invite or reject each candidate on the spot.
quote_en: Usually when we have time, we let people apply, and suddenly we see a very big bucket there. / As soon as someone applies, maybe twice a day I go and check. / I look; this one was good, I invite them right there.

anchors.quote: من تو رلای اخیری که داشتیم من هایرینگ منیجر بودم و نفر اول مصاحبه هم خودم
این باعث شد که حجم خیلی زیادی همونجا اولش من ریجکت می‌کنم
میان من سعی می‌کنم خیلی سختگیر باشم رو مرحله اولش چرا چون مرحله دوم سوم یعنی وقت بقیه بچه‌ها تیمم می‌خوان بگیرن

claim_en: In the recruiter's recent roles as hiring manager, they ran the first interview themselves instead of the recruiter, rejected a large share at that stage, and stayed strict there because later stages take the team's time.
quote_en: In the recent roles we had, I was the hiring manager and the first interviewer was me myself. / This meant that I reject a very large volume right there at the start. / Those who come, I try to be very strict in the first stage. Why? Because the second and third stages take the time of the rest of my team.

anchors.quote: اگه چند ماه بازه اینا استخدام بکن نیستن آره مسخره بازیه خیلی از شرکتا هستن که فقط الکی جاو
فقط می‌خوام بگم تو مارکت بگم ما مثلاً استخدام داریم
این کم نیستن شرکتهایی که این مدلین
اگه جدی باشه شرکت تو کمتر یک ماه باید ببنده جابشو اگه بیشتر نگه می‌داره واقعاً اونا استخدام بکن نیستن

claim_en: Many companies post job ads without intending to hire, to show the market they are hiring; a serious company closes a role in under a month, so one left open for several months is likely not a real opening.
quote_en: If it is open for several months, they are not hiring; it is a farce; many companies just post fake jobs. / I just want to tell the market that we are hiring. / Companies like this are not few. / If the company is serious, it should close the job in under a month; if it keeps it longer, they are really not hiring.

anchors.quote: یا فقط باز می‌کنن برای کسی که آردی خودشون میخوان استخدام کنن
معمولا م میگی رفر کن یعنی یه نفر داخلی رفر بود

claim_en: Some roles are opened only for someone the company already wants to hire, usually an internal referral.
quote_en: Or they only open it for someone they already want to hire. / Usually you say: refer; that is, someone internal was referred.
